description: Header file defining the ApplicationAndroid class for Android applications within the Starboard framework. It manages application lifecycle, input events, and system commands via ALooper, and provides methods for handling Android-specific events and resource overlays.

classes.name: ApplicationAndroid
classes.description: Represents an Android application within the Starboard framework, handling lifecycle, input, and system events via ALooper.

methods.name: ApplicationAndroid
methods.description: Constructor initializing ApplicationAndroid with ALooper and optional event callback.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ApplicationAndroid.

methods.name: CreateWindow
methods.description: Creates a new application window with specified options.

methods.name: SendTTSChangedEvent
methods.description: Injects an event indicating TTS settings have changed.

methods.name: SendAndroidCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the Android application with specified type and data.

methods.name: SendAndroidMotionEvent
methods.description: Sends a motion event to the application.

methods.name: SendAndroidKeyEvent
methods.description: Sends a key event to the application.

methods.name: SbWindowSendInputEvent
methods.description: Sends input text or composition state.

methods.name: SendLowMemoryEvent
methods.description: Notifies the application of low memory conditions.

methods.name: app_start_with_android_fix
methods.description: Returns the application start timestamp with Android-specific fix.

methods.name: SendDateTimeConfigurationChangedEvent
methods.description: Notifies that date/time configuration has changed.

methods.name: GetOverlayedIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer overlay variable by name.

methods.name: GetOverlayedStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string overlay variable by name.

methods.name: GetOverlayedBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean overlay variable by name.
